headline: Moment Residence / APOLLO Architects & Associates
context: Perched atop a rise on a sloping street within a quiet residential neighborhood, Moment is surrounded by a retaining wall and perimeter enclosure that conceal the interior from the street below, ensuring a high degree of privacy.
